newsitem.title: FRANCE: Michelin does not dispute profit forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Michelin does not dispute profit forecasts.

text.p: French tyremaker Michelin did not dispute a consensus 1996 profit forecast, before provisions, of 3.0 to 3.5 billion francs, a company official said on Tuesday.

"The analysts' consensus was for between 3.0 billion and 3.5 billion francs before knowing about the Spanish provision. We'll have to see how they modify their forecasts. In general, when we do not comment it means we are not formally in disagreement," finance director Eric Bourdais told reporters.
Michelin earlier said net profit fell to 1.35 billion francs in the first half from 1.51 billion after a 709 million franc charge to restructure Spanish subsidiary Neumaticos Michelin.
Bourdais said the effect of lower raw material prices would be felt in the second half of 1997.
In 1995, the company more than doubled its profits from the year-earlier period with a net attributable profit of 2.796 billion francs compared to 1.291 billion in 1994.
